'''Director of Agriculture''' was a managerial position of the [[Rysais Producers Co-operative]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Thanek]] held this post.
